title: Babanın şarkısı

characters.DAD: a father in his forties with short black hair and a thick black mustache, wearing a brown corduroy jacket
characters.KID: a girl of about ten with a dark ponytail, wearing a blue hoodie
characters.WOMAN: a woman of about thirty with a dark ponytail, wearing a blue wool coat
characters.OLDDAD: the same father, now in his seventies with white hair and a white mustache, wearing a brown corduroy jacket

scenes.text:
Babanın arabada açtığı eski şarkılardan
neden o kadar sıkılırdın?
scenes.prompt: Inside an old car on a country road at sunset, {DAD} drives on the left humming happily, while {KID} sits in the passenger seat on the right with her arms crossed, rolling her eyes.

scenes.text:
Hep aynı kaset,
her yolculukta aynı nakarat.
scenes.prompt: An old red car drives along a winding road through autumn hills at sunset, golden leaves blowing across the road. No people visible.

scenes.text:
Yıllar sonra bir gece,
o şarkı radyoda çaldı.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy night, {WOMAN} sits alone in the driver's seat of a parked car, rain streaming down the windshield, city lights glowing, she looks surprised and moved.
In the same parked car on the rainy night, {WOMAN} smiles with teary eyes, singing softly to herself, warm light from the street lamps on her face.

scenes.text:
O şarkıyı bir de onunla dinle.
Bunu babana gönder.
scenes.prompt: On an autumn road at sunset, {OLDDAD} drives on the left smiling proudly, while {WOMAN} sits in the passenger seat on the right laughing, golden leaves falling.

caption:
Babanın şarkısı neydi?

Sıkıldığın o şarkı şimdi seni ona götürüyor. 🤍

Bunu babana gönder.
